props.name: Sniper Focus

props.classMechanic_text:
SNIPER’S FOCUS

BUILDING FOCUS

When wielding a Ranged Firearm, a Sniper gradually builds up Focus—a special resource that represents heightened awareness and concentration on a target.

You begin tracking Focus once you acquire the 【Sniper Focus】 skill. At the end of your turn, if you did not perform a damaging action, you gain 1 Focus. If you are 【Hidden】, you gain 1 Focus regardless of your actions. You can accumulate Focus up to a maximum equal to your level in 【Sniper Focus】.

SPENDING FOCUS

Focus can be spent to enhance your precision or unleash powerful attacks. When you make an attack with a Ranged Firearm:

  • You gain +1 Accuracy per Focus (via 【Take Aim】).

  • You may spend all of your Focus to deal +10 bonus damage per Focus spent.

Some skills, such as 【Perfect Sniping】, allow you to spend a single Focus to apply additional effects, such as Homing, or allow your shot to bypass Hidden and Isolate.

FOCUS MANAGEMENT

Building Focus requires patience and careful timing. If you engage too early, you may lose the opportunity to deal maximum damage. On the other hand, waiting too long may leave you vulnerable.

You may gain Focus even in the midst of combat by coordinating with 【Camouflage】 or by delaying your offensive actions.

props.class_lore:
Snipers are silent executioners—those who trade the chaos of close combat for the deadly certainty of a single, well-placed shot. With a steady hand and a sharp eye, they wait patiently in the shadows, calculating every angle and heartbeat before they pull the trigger.

In some cultures, Snipers are seen as ghost-like legends—hunters of men who disappear before the sound of the shot catches up to the kill. In war, they are whispered about in fear. In peace, they are rarely seen at all.
